items.headline: Daily-dividend vote and next earnings release need follow-up
items.change: Issuer communications describe November STRC daily dividends at a 12% annual rate as conditional on shareholder approval on October 28. The Q3 earnings call is scheduled for October 29 at 5 pm Eastern. No vote result is inferred.
items.relevance: Review actual approval/effective terms and cash-payment timing before changing the preferred liquidity model.

items.headline: No BTC purchases; STRC claims reduced through repurchases
items.change: Issuer reports 848,517 BTC; 2,068,459 STRC shares repurchased for $204.9 million; $4.83 billion USD reserve and $242.4 million other USD cash.
items.relevance: Repurchase lowers preferred face claims and cash together; does not itself establish a treasury-thesis failure.

items.headline: Latest proxy solicitations continued to advocate daily dividends
items.change: October 20 DEFA14A filings contain management interviews/social communications about the pending daily-dividend vote; no vote result or effective certificate is established by these communications.
items.relevance: Solicitation language about stability/demand remains an issuer claim. The legal amendment still requires the voting and filing conditions.

items.headline: Strategy reached 848,517 BTC; repurchase authorization raised to $3bn
items.change: Week bought 267 BTC for $22.1m, sold 140,872 common shares for $22m net, and repurchased 1,938,780 STRC for $193.1m using USD Cash. USD Reserve paid $45.5m preferred dividends. Reserve $4.83bn; USD Cash $447.3m. Aggregate repurchase authorization is $3bn inclusive of past purchases, with $1.16bn remaining.
items.relevance: Latest official weekly snapshot. Separate $5.2773bn total designated liquidity into reserve/restricted-policy uses and flexible cash; do not assume $3bn is unspent or guaranteed. Buybacks retire preferred claims while spending cash.

items.headline: Board declared November daily STRC payments conditional on vote and charter
items.change: Conditional calendar-day record dates November 1-30, total $1.00/share; first payment November 2 and final payment December 1. If conditions fail, daily payments do not become payable and the semi-monthly fallback remains.
items.relevance: An already-declared conditional schedule is stronger than a marketing intention but still depends on approval and timely effective documents.

items.headline: MSCI screening changes scheduled to take effect at November 30 close
items.change: Implementation is future and dependent on final review actions.
items.relevance: Potential flow/financing-premium effects differ from BTC fundamentals and may be anticipated before implementation.

items.headline: MSCI final November affected-company list is scheduled
items.change: The final list is a future publication at cutoff.
items.relevance: Reassess issuer-specific deletion/addition implications and actual passive exposure; do not forecast forced dollar selling without holdings evidence.

items.headline: MSCI adopted non-operating-company eligibility screens
items.change: New operating-asset/five-ratio framework takes effect November 30 close; final affected list scheduled November 11. January deferral of the narrow DATCO proposal is not the current policy endpoint.
items.relevance: MSTR is flagged for potential deletion in the preliminary list. ASST was a non-constituent in the August DATCO list, so its reviewed risk is addition eligibility/sector spillover, not an announced deletion. Exact flows and price impact are unverified.

items.headline: Strategy bought 250 BTC and retired 1.932m STRC shares
items.change: Bought 250 BTC for $21.5m; 125,183 common shares sold for $21m net. Repurchased 1,932,145 STRC for $192.4m. Holdings 848,250 BTC; reserve $4.88bn and USD Cash $640.5m.
items.relevance: A large preferred buyback relative to new BTC purchases reduces senior carry but consumes flexible liquidity; current issuance and claim retirement must both enter common valuation.

items.headline: Q3 results scheduled after October 29 U.S. market close
items.change: Issuer scheduled third-quarter results after market close October 29 and a 17:00 Eastern live webinar.
items.relevance: Refresh actual cash flow, debt/puts, preferred claims, reserve restrictions, tax allowances, custody and contingent liabilities; the event is scheduled, not a forecast of results.

items.headline: Definitive proxy opened voting and updated control disclosure
items.change: October 28 virtual meeting; voting record September 25. Ownership table reports Saylor 32.9% total voting power at the disclosed snapshot.
items.relevance: Super-voting influence remains material, but an old majority-control assertion should not be reused. Proposed cadence change is not yet adopted.

items.headline: Quarter-boundary report separates September and October transactions
items.change: September 28-30: no ATM or BTC purchase; 1,033,168 STRC repurchased for $102.6m. October 1-4: 334 BTC acquired for $28.7m; 92,894 common sold for $15.7m net; 740,634 STRC retired for $73.7m.
items.relevance: Quarter-end snapshot differs from later weekly balances. Respect period cutoffs and separate reserve income, USD Cash and ATM funding.

items.headline: STRC October 31 payment declared; November payment has a fallback condition
items.change: STRC retained 12%; October 31 $0.50 dividend unconditional on daily proposal. November 15 $0.50 declaration is replaced only if daily amendments pass and STRC certificate is timely effective.
items.relevance: Treat alternative daily and semi-monthly paths as mutually conditional; adding both would double count November cash distributions.

items.headline: Common issuance funded BTC and STRC repurchases continued
items.change: Bought 1,665 BTC for $142.7m using common ATM proceeds; repurchased 1,534,530 STRC for $151.7m. Reserve paid $22.1m preferred dividends; reserve $5.02bn and USD Cash $1.00bn.
items.relevance: Common dilution, BTC growth and senior retirement must be jointly evaluated; headline BTC accumulation alone omits carry and liquidity movements.

items.headline: Board submitted calendar-day preferred dividend amendments to shareholders
items.change: Proposal covers STRF/STRC/STRK/STRD, with each calendar day a record date and next business-day payment. It does not change annual rates or aggregate regular dividend obligations. Approval and filed effective certificates are required.
items.relevance: Frequency changes may affect demand/administration but do not create extra annual cash income or remove credit risk.

items.headline: USD Cash funded BTC purchases and preferred retirement
items.change: Bought 950 BTC for $75.7m and repurchased 1,771,238 STRC for $174m from USD Cash. Reserve paid $57.4m preferred dividends/interest; reserve $5.04bn and USD Cash $1.05bn.
items.relevance: Separately measure operating liquidity, payments and capital deployment; stable gross holdings do not mean no cash outflow.

items.headline: Digital Credit repurchase authorization increased to $2bn
items.change: Authorized aggregate purchase price increased from $1bn to $2bn; $1.19bn remained. Week repurchased 1,810,885 STRC for $176.3m from USD Cash; no ATM sale or BTC trade in the period.
items.relevance: Authorization is capacity, not an executed purchase or independent liquidity. Actual retirement lowers future cash requirements while consuming flexible cash.

items.headline: Preferred declarations retain STRC 12% and scheduled quarterlies
items.change: Declared September 30 quarterly distributions for STRF/STRK/STRD and euro STRE, plus STRC semi-monthlies for September 30 and October 15. STRC retained 12% annual rate.
items.relevance: Different series have different currency, cumulative, conversion and nonpayment rights. STRE adds EUR/USD exposure; return-of-capital guidance is an expectation, not guaranteed tax treatment.

items.headline: Strategy resumed BTC purchases while continuing STRC repurchases
items.change: Bought 4,603 BTC for $369.7m and repurchased 1,557,177 STRC for $151.8m. Holdings 845,050 BTC; reserve $5.10bn; USD Cash $1.61bn.
items.relevance: Capital allocation can alternate between BTC purchases, reserve building and claim retirement; each has a different effect on gross BTC and residual NAV.

items.headline: Strategy created a flexible USD Cash pool separate from USD Reserve
items.change: New USD Cash may fund BTC, dividends/interest, security repurchases, debt repayment and reserve increases. As of August 23 reserve $5.10bn; USD Cash $1.59bn. Week included 18,261,118 common shares sold for $2,006.5m net and $136.4m STRC repurchases.
items.relevance: Combine liquid assets once for valuation but retain policy restrictions when measuring available repurchase cash. The two pools cannot be casually treated as identical or double counted.

items.headline: Further BTC sales funded STRC retirement
items.change: Sold 1,690 BTC for $108.6m; repurchased 1,152,020 STRC shares for $108.6m. Reported BTC holdings 840,447; reserve $4.65bn.
items.relevance: A smaller BTC stack can coexist with improved net common backing if sufficiently discounted senior claims are retired; do not assess solely by gross BTC.

items.headline: Strategy sold BTC to fund dividends and STRC repurchases
items.change: Sold 1,638 BTC for $104.73m in July 27-August 2; $52.4m funded preferred dividends and $52.3m STRC repurchases. Separately sold 3,011,361 MSTR shares for $290.6m net; reserve reached $4bn.
items.relevance: BTC monetization is executed, not merely hypothetical. It funds cash obligations and retires claims while reducing gross BTC; per-share residual impact needs both sides.

items.headline: Q2 release separates large BTC marks from cash and preferred outflows
items.change: Reported Q2 $8.32bn unrealized digital-asset loss and $400.7m preferred dividends. Final Q2 10-Q filed August 3. H1 tax note shows full valuation allowance on domestic net deferred tax assets.
items.relevance: BTC Yield is a gross KPI, not cash yield or a common return. Fair-value losses, tax allowances, preferred distributions and actual operating cash need separate bridges. Q3 may materially update these inputs.

items.headline: Strategy initiated STRC repurchases and expanded the reserve
items.change: Repurchased 288,930 STRC shares for $25m over July 20-26; reserve rose to $3.75bn, funded partly by $525m common ATM proceeds. Reserve policy does not authorize funding repurchases.
items.relevance: Discount repurchases retire senior claims and reduce dividend carry, but common issuance funds part of the program and the $100 STRC objective is not a price guarantee.
